provided_skills.name: transaction-concurrency-control-foundations
provided_skills.description: Provides database transaction concurrency-control background. Use when reasoning about transactions, commits and aborts, serializability, isolation anomalies, conflicts, dependencies, and protocol families such as locking, timestamp ordering, OCC, MVCC, SSI, TicToc, hybrid protocols.

provided_skills.name: transaction-protocol-reasoning
provided_skills.description: Teaches how to reason from a transaction protocol’s rules to a working model. Use when analyzing a concurrency-control paper, spec, or algorithm to identify state, metadata, invariants, operation rules, examples, counterexamples, guarantees, false aborts, unsafe commits, or tradeoffs before inspecting concrete traces.

provided_skills.name: transaction-trace-analysis
provided_skills.description: Teaches evidence-based analysis of transaction logs and traces. Use when reconstructing transaction behavior from tables, TSV/CSV files, timestamps, counters, object histories, validation records, abort records, retries, partial logs, or when producing classified transaction outputs from trace evidence.
